name: Goi la lim kim
summary: Gỏi lá lìm kìm is the mangrove-leaf salad VnExpress describes, served with cá bống sao fried crisp, or with dried fish. The leaf is also mixed with tôm thẻ. This is not the mudskipper salad. The leaf is a small watery vine. The taste changes with the rain and with the hour.
origin: Can Gio. VnExpress, 22 Sep 2021. Eco parks serve it. A gate was not named.
howToEat: Pick the leaves at dawn, when they are least astringent. Stem them, wash, drain, and leave them whole. Add herbs, thin onion, and peeled roasted peanuts. Dress lightly so the leaves stay crisp.

The sauce is sweet-sour nước mắm with garlic and chili, printed at a 1:1 ratio. From April through October, the rainy months, the leaf is thin and barely salty. In the dry months it is thicker and saltier, and the sauce is adjusted.
Fry cá bống sao crisp outside and still soft inside, take the flesh, and pour sweet-sour fish sauce over it. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Eco parks in Cần Giờ. VnExpress names no gate and no street. Check on arrival.

seoDescription: Gỏi lá lìm kìm in Can Gio is a leaf salad with fried cá bống sao or dried fish. VnExpress, 22 Sep 2021, prints a 1:1 sauce and a rainy-season leaf. The price is Check on arrival.
texture: The leaf is crisp and watery. Fried cá bống sao is crisp outside and still soft inside.
taste: Salty, sour, and a sweet finish, changing with the season. Basil, rau răm, and peanuts. The sauce is sweet, sour, salty, and hot.
